author: Shad Helmstetter
title: What to say when you talk to your self
description: The book "What to Say When You Talk to Yourself" by Shad Helmstetter offers readers a guide to overcoming negative self-talk and embracing a more positive outlook on life. The book is based on neuroscience and provides techniques to erase and replace past mental programs with healthier ones. It is considered one of the most important and helpful personal growth books ever written.
